description: Generate PayGate (APP-001) synthetic legacy codebase - ASP.NET Web API on .NET Framework 4.6.2, ~200K LoC (representative subset of 3-5K lines). IIS-hosted, SQL Server 2019 Enterprise with Always On AG, TDE, 400+ stored procedures, API key auth for merchants, Windows Auth for admin. External Visa/Mastercard SFTP integration.
steps: Create working/sample/legacy-codebases/PayGate/ directory with solution structure: PayGate.Api, PayGate.Core, PayGate.Data, PayGate.Security, PayGate.Integration, PayGate.Tests

Create PayGate.Api.csproj (.NET Framework 4.6.2, Web API 2) with web.config containing Windows Auth for /admin endpoints, API key auth via custom DelegatingHandler, connection strings to PaymentsDB, TLS 1.2 enforcement settings

Create API controllers: TransactionController (processes payments, 50K/hour at peak), SettlementController, MerchantAuthController (API key validation), AdminController (Windows Auth), HealthCheckController. Show high-throughput patterns, transaction processing logic
Create PayGate.Core.csproj with domain models (Transaction, Settlement, Merchant, PaymentMethod), services (PaymentProcessingService, SettlementService, MerchantValidationService), and business rules

Create PayGate.Data.csproj with repository pattern using both EF6 and raw ADO.NET for performance-critical paths. Include PayGateDbContext, TransactionRepository (uses raw SqlCommand for bulk inserts), SettlementRepository
Create PayGate.Security.csproj with API key validation, Windows Auth helpers, TDE-related configuration, encryption utilities
Create PayGate.Integration.csproj with SFTP client for Visa/Mastercard settlement file exchange, file format parsers (CSV, fixed-width), PGP encryption/decryption stubs

Create SQL scripts folder with representative stored procedures (20-30 of the 400+) covering transaction processing, settlement matching, merchant management, reporting aggregations. Include Always On AG setup scripts
Create packages.config files with NuGet refs: EntityFramework 6.4.4, Newtonsoft.Json, WinSCP (SFTP), Polly (resilience), System.Data.SqlClient
acceptance_criteria: PayGate.sln exists with all projects referenced
web.config shows dual auth: API key + Windows Auth sections
SFTP integration code references Visa/Mastercard settlement patterns
SQL scripts include representative stored procedures demonstrating complexity (PIVOT, CROSS APPLY, windowing functions)
Repository pattern shows both EF6 and raw ADO.NET (performance-critical paths)
packages.config present with appropriate NuGet references
verification: Verify directory structure exists with all project folders
Verify .sln file properly references all projects
Verify web.config has both Windows Auth and API key auth configuration
